rationale: Price is at 96.9% of today's range with only $0.04 left to the session high, offering virtually no long reward relative to risk; a short fade at the high is theoretically attractive but the 5-minute ATR of $0.05 is abnormally compressed, making any meaningful stop placement impractical and the candle-by-candle volume (219–1,497 shares per bar before the last push) shows no conviction to sustain a directional move. With an existing realized loss on the day and no news catalyst or comparable historical setups to validate edge, the asymmetry does not justify a position in either direction.
